steps.title: Prepare and seed A549 cells
steps.instruction: Take a 24–48 h old T‑75 flask of A549 cells, treat with Tryple Express enzyme, dislodge the adherent cells, count them using a Countess 3, and resuspend to obtain 8000 cells per 60 µL in 10 % Ham’s F12K medium; dispense the suspension into ten 1.5 mL snap‑capped tubes (225 µL each) placed in Slot 6 of the tube rack, then seed 60 µL (8000 cells) into each well of a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add negative control medium
steps.instruction: Add 10 % Ham’s F12K medium (no cells) to wells A5, B5 and C5 as negative controls.

steps.title: Prepare thapsigargin stock tubes
steps.instruction: Place a 35 µL aliquot of 1 mM Thapsigargin into tube A1 (Slot 7). Prepare additional initial stock solutions in the following tubes: A2 = 100 µM, A3 = 10 µM, A4 = 1 µM, A5 = 100 nM, A6 = 50 nM, B1 = 10 nM, all in 10 % Ham’s F12K diluent.

steps.title: Prepare 4X thapsigargin dilutions
steps.instruction: Create 4× working concentrations in tubes C1–C6 and D1–D6 as follows: C1 = 1.56 nM, C2 = 3.12 nM, C3 = 6.24 nM, C4 = 12.52 nM, C5 = 25 nM, C6 = 50 nM; D1 = 100 nM, D2 = 200 nM, D3 = 400 nM, D4 = 800 nM, D5 = 1600 nM, D6 = 2000 nM, each in 10 % Ham’s F12K medium.

steps.title: Serially dilute thapsigargin
steps.instruction: For both the initial stock tubes and the 4× working‑concentration tubes, add the appropriate volume of 10 % Ham’s F12K diluent, then add thapsigargin; pipette each mixture 3–4 times, aspirate the required volume and transfer it to the next adjacent tube to achieve the listed concentrations.

steps.title: Treat cells with thapsigargin
steps.instruction: Approximately 12–16 h after seeding, add the prepared thapsigargin dilutions to the appropriate wells of the 96‑well plate according to the experimental design.

steps.title: Add CellTox Green reagent
steps.instruction: Pick up a 20 µL tip from Slot 10, transfer 15 µL of CellTox Green reagent to each well, set the heater‑shaker to orbital shaking for 2 min at 500 rpm, then incubate the plate at room temperature for 15 min, and finally read fluorescence at 485 nm excitation / 520 nm emission on the Biotek microplate reader.

substeps.instruction: Pick up 20 µL tip from Slot 10.
Dispense 15 µL CellTox Green reagent into each well.
Read fluorescence (485 nm ex / 520 nm em).

steps.title: Add CellTiter Glo 2.0 reagent
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the heater‑shaker, pick up a 200 µL tip from Slot 4, aspirate 80 µL of CellTiter Glo 2.0 reagent from tube B1 of the Opentrons 10‑tube rack and dispense into wells A1, B1‑H1, A2‑H2, A3‑H3, A4‑F4, and A5‑C5; then orbital shake 2 min at 500 rpm, incubate 10 min at room temperature, and read luminescence on the Biotek microplate reader.

substeps.instruction: Pick up 200 µL tip from Slot 4.
Aspirate 80 µL CellTiter Glo 2.0 from B1 (tube rack).
Dispense into wells A1, B1‑H1, A2‑H2, A3‑H3, A4‑F4, A5‑C5.
